problem.title: Sum of Squares of Special Elements

approaches.title: Scan elements and test divisibility
approaches.summary: Iterate over array elements and add the square of each element whose 1-based index divides the array length. The second revision limits the scan to the first half and adds the final element separately.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Scans all elements and sums the squares at indices that divide the array length.

revisions.commitComment: slight optimisation, doesn't rly matter since n <= 50
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 2778: slight optimisation, doesn't rly matter since n <= 50
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Scans only the first half, then adds the last element’s square, since the final index always divides the length.
